Estimated from the photo: the plate holds roughly 14–15 sliced, cooked carrot pieces, possibly roasted or glazed. At about 8–10 g per slice, that comes to roughly 130 g. Roasted carrots with a little oil or glaze run about 0.8–1.0 kcal/g, so I used about 0.9 kcal/g.
